name: Angela
goal: Anti-ageing, hydration and sun protection every day. Fewer breakouts and less hyperpigmentation every month.
concerns: Light, purely hydrating textures at home in Taiwan's humid climate. More emollient when she travels somewhere dry.
Daily protection to minimise UV ageing.
Wrinkle prevention around the eyes and the smile lines. Firmness.
Occasional hormonal pimples around her period.
Hyperpigmentation left by old pimple scars.
Lip care is part of the routine.

hero.title: PDRN, high concentration
hero.text: Day and night. Prefer products where polydeoxyribonucleotide is the headline ingredient.

shopping: Medium. Best bang for buck on ingredient cleanliness and strength.
Functional beauty. K-beauty with elite ingredients at a low price.
Prestige lines that spend on fragrance, packaging and marketing.

travel.cadence: About once a month. Her calendar tells the agent where she is going next.
rows: San Francisco. More emollient moisturisers to prevent dryness.
Hawaii, Switzerland. Reef and lake friendly, high UV. Sticks or sprays for easy reapplication.
